skill.name: image-to-video
skill.description: Guide for turning still images into short videos with inference.sh belt CLI, model selection, motion prompts, camera movement, durations, and workflow examples.
skill.summary: Create short animated videos from still images with model selection and motion prompting guidance.
skill.author: halt-catch-fire

security_audit.summary: The skill is a legitimate image-to-video guide, but several examples run belt commands that contact third-party inference services and upload local media. Most backtick and reconnaissance static hits are markdown formatting or model names, while actual belt and npx command examples remain confirmed medium risk.

remediation.issue: External command examples run third-party CLI workflows.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running belt commands, especially commands that upload local images, video, or audio.

remediation.issue: Media privacy expectations are not stated before upload examples.
remediation.suggestion: Add a clear warning that belt app runs may send media to inference.sh and model providers. Recommend sanitized or approved assets.

remediation.issue: npx installation guidance depends on external packages and skills.
remediation.suggestion: Pin trusted sources or direct users to verified installation documentation before suggesting npx skill installation commands.

content.user_title: Animate Still Images Into Short Videos
content.value_statement: Still images need careful model choices and restrained motion prompts to become usable videos. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through image-to-video workflows with belt CLI examples.
actual_capabilities: Selects image-to-video models for landscapes, portraits, products, fabric, and general animation.
Provides belt CLI examples for image generation, animation, upscaling, audio, and media merging.
Explains camera movement prompts such as dolly, pan, tilt, orbit, and static shots.
Recommends motion prompt structure for subject motion, atmosphere, mood, and pace.
Gives duration guidance for short clips, looping backgrounds, and stitched sequences.
limitations: Requires a configured inference.sh belt CLI account for command examples.
Sends media to external inference services when belt commands are run.
Does not create video locally without external model access.
Quality can degrade with long clips, complex action, or low-resolution source images.

use_cases.title: Create Social Video Loops
use_cases.description: Turn a still image into a short loop with subtle motion, clear duration guidance, and a suitable model choice.

use_cases.title: Produce Product Motion Shots
use_cases.description: Plan product animations with camera movement, reflections, fabric motion, or material flow for campaign assets.

use_cases.title: Build Cinemagraph Concepts
use_cases.description: Keep most of a photo still while animating one chosen element for a clean cinemagraph effect.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Model
prompt_templates.prompt: I have a still image of [subject]. Recommend the best image-to-video model, motion direction, and clip length. Explain the choice briefly.

prompt_templates.title: Write a Motion Prompt
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an image-to-video prompt for [image description]. Include camera movement, subject motion, atmosphere, mood, and pace. Keep motion subtle.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Product Animation
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a short product animation workflow for [product]. Choose a model, motion style, duration, and review steps before adding audio.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multi-Clip Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a multi-clip image-to-video pipeline for [scene]. Include progressive motion, upscaling, audio, stitching, privacy checks, and quality review criteria.

output_examples.input: A designer has a landscape image with clouds and water.
output: Recommended model: Wan 2.5 i2v for natural motion.
Motion direction: slow pan right, water ripples, drifting clouds, warm light.
Clip length: 4 seconds for a clean social media loop.

output_examples.input: A marketing team needs a product shot with cloth movement and audio.
output_examples.output: Use Fabric 1.0 for flowing cloth, create a short product orbit, then add ambience only after motion is approved.

output_examples.input: An editor wants a 12 second scene from one still image.
output_examples.output: Generate three short clips with progressive motion, review each segment, then stitch the accepted clips into the final scene.

best_practices: Start with high-resolution images and keep motion subtle.
State camera movement, subject motion, atmosphere, and pace in one prompt.
Use short clips first, then stitch approved segments for longer results.
anti_patterns: Requesting fast action, spinning cameras, or many changes in one clip.
Uploading sensitive media without confirming external processing is acceptable.
Choosing a model by popularity instead of matching the subject and motion.

faq.question: Does this skill generate videos by itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and belt CLI command patterns for external inference services.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: It is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Do I need an account?
faq.answer: Yes. Running the examples requires an inference.sh belt CLI setup.

faq.question: Can I use sensitive images?
faq.answer: Use caution. Media may be sent to external model providers when commands run.

faq.question: Which model should I choose first?
faq.answer: Use Wan 2.5 i2v for realistic landscapes and portraits. Use Fabric for cloth or liquid motion.

faq.question: How long should clips be?
faq.answer: Start with 3 to 5 seconds. Longer clips often lose quality and should be stitched from shorter segments.
